notes: 1976 dark grey-brown board-sided townhouse cluster, stepped Hyde frontage (edges 1, 2, 4). Centre plane (edge 2): recessed red brick covered entry below a square box-bay stack. North plane (edge 1): box-bay stack with large panes. South plane (edge 4): tall plain wall with slot windows and a wide glazed box bay. Brick ground band, no cornice, dark frames. Wall darkened to charcoal-taupe, side-plane bay stacks now wide single panes (edge 1 windowW 2.2), front bay narrowed toward a box bay. 1970s stepped modern. Wall charcoal-brown board siding; no sills or caps anywhere (ribbon lights in dark frames). Front: a glazed box bay stack (storeys 1-3) left of centre over a recessed dark garage/entry, a tall slot window beside it. North plane: a banded full-height glazed stack (the second box bay with big corner glazing). South plane: slot window plus a wide glazed band. Low storey plates free the LiDAR allowance for shallow standing-seam metal roof caps on each plane. Pink base replaced by a low brick planter band. Wall pushed darker and cooler (charcoal-brown), brick planter band a deeper red-brown. Siding darker and cooler (charcoal-brown), brick planter band deep red-brown instead of salmon, front box bay a little deeper so its flat face reads. Siding pushed to dark brown-grey; the faceted glazed front bay is replaced by a squared box-bay stack (frame with solid spandrel bands between floors, one large dark-framed window per floor) plus the slot window; north plane loses its strip glazing for a squared stack with one large window per floor and dark trim bands; south plane is a squared glazed stack on the upper two floors over plain siding with a slot window; ground is a dark recessed garage panel and entry over a low brick planter line (roll-up door gone); roof edges dark standing-seam with a thin dark coping instead of pale flashing. Posts thinned to hairlines so each plane reads as siding with one large punched dark-framed window per floor and a flat dark spandrel band between floors. Rework B: cooler dark taupe-grey siding (tint held at the 0.10 luminance floor); the ribbon grid and full-width band courses are gone. Left plane: a narrow box stack, one wide window per storey with wood ledges, rising as a flat-topped tower block above the eave, red brick undercroft with a deep dark recess at the ground. Centre plane: blank siding with two small narrow windows at storeys 3-4 only, the stair door at the ground. Right (set-back) plane: blank siding at storeys 1-2 and one large glazed opening per storey at storeys 3-4 with blinds, under a grey standing-seam hip. Terracotta base band and roller door removed. Not doable with style keys: the angled projection of the right bay (projecting bays are front-edge only) and brick planters/paving. Left box-stack ledges a dark brown timber (~#5a4d42 in game); brick at its true red; the left ground recess lined in shadowed brick instead of a dark panel; the right plane's ground storey is a 1.5 m dark recess over a brick planter band; the centre slits a little taller. Two slit columns on the centre planes, so both are kept. Not doable: the canted oriel on the set-back right plane (projecting bays are front-edge only). The right ground recess is now dark brick (a brick undercroft with planters, not a garage door), left tower box-stack ledges project 0.3 m. Board texture, angled right bays and sloped roof edge: kit limits / already present. Dark vertical siding, brick undercroft behind planters (no garage door), box-bay stack left, slit windows centre, canted glazed bays right. Wall tint is game-calibrated. Brick undercroft tints darkened so the recess reads as shadowed brick, not a red door. Not doable: canted right bays (front-edge-only projection), herringbone paving, standing-seam texture. Clapboard fix (2026-10-02): painted siding moved from the stained-timber wood-siding base to painted-clapboard so the tint renders as paint, not olive. Tint lift (2026-10-02): wall tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k).
